---
title: Quickstart
description: Build a Calimero app into a calimero:app component, create it on a local cluster, and call a method.
sidebar:
  order: 2
---

import { Steps, Aside, CardGrid, LinkCard } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

This walks from an app's crate to a method call on a local cluster. An app is
a `calimero:app` component, written with the Rust SDK (`calimero-app-sdk`) and
built with `calimero-app-build`; the [tutorial](/build/tutorial/) is the long
form, checking output at every step.

<Aside type="note">
  The commands are taken from `apps/kv-store/`, `crates/app-build` and the CLI
  definitions (`crates/meroctl/src`). Run `meroctl <command> --help` to confirm
  them for your build; every command is in the
  [meroctl reference](/operate/meroctl/).
</Aside>

<Steps>

1. **Rust with the `wasm32-wasip2` target** (core's `rust-toolchain.toml`
   lists it):

   ```sh
   rustup target add wasm32-wasip2
   ```

2. **Test the app** on the real engine, with no node (`TestApp`, in
   `calimero-app-sdk`'s `testing` module):

   ```sh
   cargo test --manifest-path apps/kv-store/Cargo.toml
   ```

3. **Build the component**:

   ```sh
   cargo run -p calimero-app-build --bin mero-app-build -- apps/kv-store --out kv_store.wasm
   ```

4. **Start a development cluster** and sign in (mock attestation, a passkey in
   a file):

   ```sh
   cargo run -p merod -- local
   meroctl node add local http://127.0.0.1:2501/ --allow-mock
   meroctl login --dev-passkey ./dev-passkey.json --name alice
   ```

5. **Create an instance and call it**:

   ```sh
   meroctl context create --name my-kv --path kv_store.wasm --alias my-kv
   meroctl call -c my-kv set --args '{"key": "hello", "value": "world"}'
   meroctl call -c my-kv get --args '{"key": "hello"}' --view
   ```

6. **Package it for a real cluster**: a signed `.mpk`
   ([Packaging & signing](/build/packaging-signing/)):

   ```sh
   python3 -I scripts/pack-component.py --wasm kv_store.wasm --package com.example.kv \
     --app-version 0.1.0 --out dist/com.example.kv-0.1.0.mpk
   ```

</Steps>
